speaker: SPEAKER_00
transcript: Dear Senator McConnell, while you have been a Republican Senate Majority Leader, you are the biggest abuser of the Do-Nothing Congress. During Obama's presidency, you politically castrated him so badly that the only thing he could do was sign executive orders to get anything done. Ever since Reagan broke unions, Reagan cut off Social Security disability to everyone. This started the homeless problem. Reagan never raised a minimum wage. Reagan created a first of the three tax breaks for the rich, followed by George W. Bush and your gift to the billionaires, the Trump tracks break of 2017. 85% of the American corporations created stockback buy options with their tax breaks. The American corporations did not expand, did not hire, or buy anything. Today's stock market is going great only because President Trump is making a federal reserve by American corporate stock shares with taxpayers' money for the first time in U.S. history. 85% of your tax breaks went to the billionaires. How many billionaires live in Kentucky? You, Mitch McConnell, have not raised a minimum wage in 12 years. How many people in Kentucky work at minimum wage jobs? Starved a Beast was started by Reagan, abused by New Kindrick, and you, Mitch McConnell, the Republicans defund all social programs, cutting government responsibilities. Housing and urban development used to build housing for the poor, not anymore. There used to be dairy products, milk and cheese and vegetables for the poor, not anymore. You and the Republicans have not raised a federal gas tax since 1992. That's almost 30 years ago. There is no federal funding to fix the roads and bridges and help fund local public transportation. I am asking you for a nickel increase for two years. That's all. Gasoline prices are at their lowest in 15 years. All road and bridge construction work be done with union workers. You are responsible for the 2006 bill that makes the U.S. Postal Service pay future health care costs. No one has to do this. You are trying to destroy the Postal Union workers so you can privatize the U.S. Postal Service. You and the media lied to the public about the Postal Service financial problems. Only late night show comedian Stephen Colbert and Seth Meyers told the truth that the Postal Service is profitable without paying future health care costs. I want you to make legislation getting rid of the burden of paying future healthcare costs so the Postal Service becomes profitable. The U.S. Postal Services can also create bank accounts for rural America. How many Kentuckians have bank accounts in rural Kentucky? Expanding the Postal Service to help rural Kentucky and rural America is your responsibility. Do you care more about Wall Street billionaires over rural Kentuckians? I am an economic developing micro-landing proposal that specializes in small business startups. When Janet Yellen was a Federal Reserve Chairwoman, her last public speech was my plan. Not if Janet Yellen is going to be the next Treasurer's Secretary, I will send her my federal grant proposal. This can work in rural America and urban America. I have made copies of this letter for the Kentucky governor and the four major Kentucky cities, major newspapers, to have all the residents of Kentucky realize that you have to work with Democrats to move our country forward.

explicit_propositions.text: Mitch McConnell served as Republican Senate Majority Leader.
Reagan did not raise the minimum wage during his presidency.
American corporations used tax breaks primarily for stock buybacks rather than expansion, hiring, or investment.
During Obama's presidency, Mitch McConnell politically constrained Obama significantly.
The Trump tax cuts of 2017 were a significant benefit to billionaires.
85% of corporate tax breaks under recent administrations were captured by billionaires.
The rise in homelessness began after Reagan dismantled labor unions.
Reagan initiated the first of three major tax breaks for the wealthy.
Reagan ended Social Security disability benefits for all recipients.
George W. Bush implemented another tax break for the wealthy.

assumptions.text: Tax policy should prioritize broad-based economic growth over wealth concentration.
The federal government bears moral and political responsibility to address poverty and inequality.
Public infrastructure projects like roads and bridges should be funded through progressive taxation.
Unionized labor contributes meaningfully to equitable economic outcomes.
The profitability of the U.S. Postal Service depends on eliminating its obligation to pre-fund future healthcare costs.
Economic policies should reflect the interests of rural communities over those of Wall Street elites.
The media fails to report accurately on key economic issues unless challenged by comedians.
Democratic cooperation is necessary to enact meaningful national reform.
Micro-business development is a viable path to revitalizing regional economies.
Janet Yellen supports innovative economic proposals focused on inclusive growth.
